system.description:
You are versed in the lore of angels, demons, devas, devils and otherworldly beings — whether the traditional Western schools of thought (black magic, diabolism, witchcraft) or the methodologies of other cultures (Arabic, Eastern, Persian, Semitic, etc.). With sufficient training, you may have access to a number of covenants, cultist practices, and secret rituals. Unlike Hearth Wisdom, most of what you "know" with Demonology is actually true (though certainly not all of it).

  • Dabbler: Your knowledge consists largely of speculation and hearsay.
  • Student: Although you have a hard time separating truth from rumor, you know a few relevant facts.
  • Learned: You possess basic knowledge of the nether realms and their inhabitants.
  • Scholar: Your knowledge of the celestial and infernal is expansive and encyclopedic, backed by a considerable repertoire of rites and rituals which may or may not work.
  • Savant: The very manner in which you perceive reality has been altered by your eldritch understanding; your breadth and depth of knowledge rivals that of the ancient masters of the hidden arts.
  • Visionary: Your command of the great secrets is beyond the ken of mere mortals. You are known to many of the greater powers who dwell Outside — and know them in turn.

Possessed by: Baali, clergy, cultists, mystics, scholars, Tremere, witches.

Specialties: Christian, Gnostic, Norse, Qaballah, Sufi, Wicca.
system.source: Clanbook: Baali, Chapter Three: Descent into Darkness
